title: Forgiveness
status: draft: written 19 Nov 2026 offline for Grade 3 Christian Religious Education; not yet checked by a CRE teacher; not loaded by the live tutor

skills.key_step: The child retells the unforgiving servant (Matthew 18:21-35) and says we forgive others as God forgives us.

floor.question: What did the father do when his son came home?

representations: a big and a small pile of paper coins
contexts: a sibling who breaks a toy

board.do: Write: big debt forgiven, small debt not forgiven.

board.say: What should the servant have done?

board.do: Wait for the child to say forgive him too.
Write: forgive as God forgives us.

misconceptions.ask: How many times did Jesus say we should forgive?
misconceptions.repair: Read Matthew 18:21-22. Seventy-seven means keep forgiving.

misconceptions.ask: What did the king do when the servant begged?
misconceptions.repair: Act out both scenes in order with three children.
Draw a mountain of coins and a small pile.

misconceptions.ask: A friend says sorry for breaking your pencil. What does forgiving mean?
misconceptions.repair: Say: forgiving means letting go of anger and not taking revenge. If someone keeps hurting you, tell an adult.

checks.question: How many times did Jesus say to forgive?
What did the unforgiving servant do?
checks.answer: Refused to forgive his fellow servant
